content: PRIMARY-VERIFIED (docs.astral.sh + pipx.pypa.io + local uv 0.13.7 resolution experiments + PyPI): uv tool install = isolated env per app (--with/--python/--index), uvx ephemeral; pipx equivalent (uses uv internally when available). torch: PyPI 2.15.0 (2026-10-28) requires py>=3.11, last py3.10=2.14.1; Linux PyPI wheel 539MB + nvidia-cudnn-cu13 517MB + nccl 207MB + cusparselt/nvshmem/triton = multi-GB CUDA; macOS/win PyPI wheels CPU-only (139/127MB). CPU index: 2.15.0+cpu cp313 manylinux=210MB, 2.14.1+cpu cp310=196MB, NO cp310 for 2.15.0+cpu. LINUX-TARGET EXPERIMENT (uv pip compile --python-platform x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu): --index https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu (additional) DOES override PyPI -> torch==2.15.0+cpu (CLI indexes take precedence, first-match); PyPI-only -> torch==2.15.0 CUDA. macOS-target test was platform-confounded (mac wheels carry no +cpu tag). Install recipe: uv tool install 'docsif[embed]' --index https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu on Linux; plain on macOS/win. Dev pattern: [[tool.uv.index]] explicit=true + [tool.uv.sources] torch pin.
